goal: Close the remaining trust, routing, and reliability gaps in the v5 redesign with thin, verifiable slices that can run cleanly through Loopsmith drain mode.
userProblem: Phase 3 shipped the core v5 surfaces, but the app still has a few gaps between passing tests and behaving like a trustworthy personal workspace in normal use. The remaining issues are concentrated in Ask honesty, summary truthfulness, Recall stability, deterministic creation flows, and backend validation reliability.
whyNow: These are the highest-leverage post-launch fixes because they affect trust, correctness, and the dependability of autonomous delivery itself. Closing them in thin slices reduces regression risk and improves the quality of future Loopsmith runs.

dataOrApiDependencies: Summary counts must be derived from live v4 endpoints or omitted when unsupported.
Recall stability work must preserve existing search and detail navigation behavior.
Backend test isolation changes must continue to protect production data and keep TEST_DATABASE_URL pointed at the test database only.
writePathsAffected: Optional typed entity creation or capture handoff payload shape

tasks.title: Stabilize the Loopsmith execution loop and backend test reset path
tasks.description: Fix the backend test isolation path so focused and strict validation can run reliably without recurring deadlocks or indefinite hangs. Use the outcome to tighten the first-run validation for subsequent slices and document any loop-level learnings in the execution tracker.
acceptanceCriteria: A bounded readiness check for this repo completes without hanging indefinitely; if strict doctor still cannot fully pass, the blocker is made explicit and reproducible.
Backend test isolation no longer relies on the current deadlock-prone truncate path without mitigation.
Focused backend validation for the changed isolation path passes on the test database.
EXECUTION-TRACKER.md records the concrete Loopsmith/autonomy learnings from this slice so later runs inherit them.
tasks.validationEvidence: Cherry-picked slice commit onto main after pytest.ini fix; 389 backend tests pass.

tasks.title: Normalize Ask responses to a single honest IDK contract
tasks.description: Make Ask return the full low-confidence IDK envelope whenever the final answer is effectively 'I do not know', even if retrieval initially found weak or misleading context. Close the backend/frontend contract gap so the UI never renders an honest IDK as a grounded answer.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/v4/ask returns the canonical low-confidence IDK shape whenever the final answer has no grounded support.
The IDK shape does not include misleading citations.
Backend tests cover the case where retrieval returns weak context but final answer should still be IDK.
Frontend tests cover the rendered IDK state for that normalized response shape.
validationCommands: cd /Volumes/lex1t/dev/shared/repos/engram && curl -fsS -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v4/ask -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"question":"What did Danish decide about Phase 4 of the v5 redesign?"}' | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d["confidence"]=="low"; assert d["citations"]==[]'
tasks.validationEvidence: Cherry-picked slice commit onto main after pytest.ini fix; 389 backend tests pass.

tasks.title: Make top-bar counts truthful
tasks.description: Replace hardcoded or placeholder top-bar counts with values derived from live API contracts, or suppress unsupported counts instead of showing false zeroes. The shell must not present false precision.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v4/summary exposes truthful count fields for the top bar or the UI hides unsupported pills.
App shell no longer hardcodes threads or recall counts to zero.
Frontend and backend tests cover the selected truthful behavior.
validationCommands: cd /Volumes/lex1t/dev/shared/repos/engram && curl -fsS http://localhost:5001/api/v4/summary | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert "today_count" in d'

tasks.title: Harden Recall routing and async search behavior
tasks.description: Replace the fragile Recall opener history shim with a route-safe pattern and prevent stale async search responses from overwriting newer ones. Preserve the overlay UX without relying on brittle browser history assumptions.
acceptanceCriteria: /recall behaves predictably on direct load, refresh, and in-app navigation.
Recall search ignores stale responses from older queries.
Focused UI tests cover both route behavior and async search ordering.

tasks.title: Make entity-list New flows deterministic
tasks.description: Align the New action on entity list screens with actual product intent. Either create the requested entity type directly or make the UI explicitly reflect a capture-first flow; do not leave the current semantic mismatch in place.
acceptanceCriteria: New on list screens matches the promised behavior for that entity type.
If creation remains capture-first, the UI copy and tests make that contract explicit.
Focused tests cover the selected creation path end to end at the component level.

tasks.title: Close the loop with smoke coverage and captured learnings
tasks.description: Add the smallest high-signal interaction coverage needed to validate the repaired flows and record what improved or failed in the autonomous loop itself. This slice is where the app-level fixes are verified as a coherent user experience rather than isolated patches.
acceptanceCriteria: Capture retry success-after-failure is covered by an automated test.
A focused smoke path covers Ask honest IDK, Recall open/search, and the entity-list New flow.
EXECUTION-TRACKER.md records the concrete Loopsmith/autonomous-delivery learnings from this hardening loop.
validationCommands: cd /Volumes/lex1t/dev/shared/repos/engram/ui && npm test -- V5CaptureSheet V5AskSheet V5Recall V5EntityList
